changes: New: FA.1 now includes a Commissioning Checklist (BS 5839-6 Annex C) in the Testing step — 6 items covering detectors, sounders, installation spec, cables, client briefing and documentation.

New: FA.2 now includes a Periodic Inspection Checklist (BS 5839-6 Annex B) in the Testing step — 10 items covering each device test, sounders, interlink, battery, building alterations, detector positioning, contamination, wiring, previous recommendations and log update.
Both checklists print on the certificate (Page 2) as a formal Routine Inspection Checks or Commissioning Checks table.
